instructions: Does the candidate's experience and skill set align with the requirements of the job description?

criteria.true: The candidate demonstrates sufficient alignment with the core requirements of the job description through direct experience or relevant transferable skills. Gaps in non-essential skills, domain experience or educational qualifications are acceptable where relevant experience can compensate.
criteria.false: The candidate lacks essential technical skills, specialist expertise or the level of experience critical to performing the role, and these gaps cannot reasonably be compensated for by transferable skills or equivalent experience.
